notes: A to-do list. To do in the sidebar holds your own list beside what the app noticed from your work: papers to mark, papers to hand back, a class with no lesson planned, missing work to chase. Those go by themselves when the work is done, and each kind can be switched off.
Type a to-do the way you would say it, like “Call Bram’s parents friday”, and it picks out the day, the class and the student. Press N anywhere outside a paper to add one.
A to-do can have a day, a class, a student or assignment it goes with, a repeat and a note. Today shows a short card of what is overdue or due today.

Week, at the top right of To do, shows your week: each line on its day, under the class that meets then. Type in a day to add one, or drag a line to another day. Anything not done moves to today on its own.
